summary: Iteration 2 full test of GridLink SL communicator (new: real LLUDP sim circuit, IM chip row from live friend list, per-session real groups, presence polling, resident search + friend request). Backend: 18/18 pytest tests pass including REAL Second Life grid login (Kaleaon Resident @ agni) — circuit connected within ~10s, region_name resolved, >100 real friend names (no 'Resident xxxxxxxx' placeholders), real groups list (non-mock), Torley Linden resident search hit, local chat send returned 200, logout clean. Offline: groups persisted per session, im/conversations empty then populated after send, friend request upserts +1 friend, resident search returns Linden results with is_friend flags, logout wipes groups. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): OFFLINE login → CHAT screen shows green LINK badge; IM segment lists ALL(3) chip + Ruth/Governor/Magnum chips with green dots (NOT hardcoded — matches /api/friends online set); ScopePicker modal opens with filter input; sending IM to a chip persists; GROUP segment shows The Sandbox / Firestorm Support / Builders Guild; local chat echo intact; Friends tab: subtitle '> 3 online / 5 total · live · sync HH:MM:SS' with account-plus icon (open-search), tapping a row deep-links to Chat with placeholder 'say to <friend name>...'; Search screen: type 'lind' → 9 results with ADD buttons, tap ADD → OFFERED; back returns; More tab shows 'sim link' row; Inventory shows 'My Inventory' + 11 typed folders. No React Native / deprecated-package issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew to 903 lines — still monolithic but readable. Consider splitting login/circuit/chat/search into modules if it grows further.
Class-scoped pytest fixture defined as instance method emits PytestRemovedIn10Warning. Non-blocking; would be a one-line refactor using @classmethod in the future.
The offline resident-search directory (11 Linden names) is hardcoded inside search_residents endpoint — fine for demo, but if reused elsewhere consider hoisting to a module-level constant.
seed_data_creation: Each offline login seeds 5 friends, 12 inventory folders, 3 groups per session. Test session cleanup via /api/logout in fixture teardown; grid session also logged out to release the SL circuit slot.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL env var is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Grid tests use REAL SL creds from /app/memory/test_credentials.md (Kaleaon Resident / SealofRassilon02, grid=agni). SL allows only ONE live circuit per avatar, so grid tests always logout and pause ~3s before logging in again. Never send friend requests to real residents in grid mode. Chat scope for IM/group is now a UUID (friend id / group id), not a name. ScopePicker Modal uses presentationStyle='pageSheet' — on web preview it renders as a full overlay. Bottom tab labels are CHAT / FRIENDS / INV / MORE (not 'INVENTORY').
